title: HTS Tariff Classification & GenAI RAG Pipeline
subtitle: Hierarchical Legal Document Classification with Hybrid Retrieval (BM25 + RRF)
description: Production-grade AI-assisted tariff classification engine processing 4,500+ pages of the U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule. Combines lexical BM25 and dense vector embeddings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) matching.
architecture: Client Query -> Query Rewriting Node -> Hybrid Search (BM25 + Chroma Embeddings) -> RRF Rank Fusion -> Hierarchical Node Traversal (Chapters/Headings) -> GRI Legal Note Evaluator -> Structured LLM Output
highlights: Engineered multi-stage classification combining query rewriting, lexical BM25, and semantic vector retrieval.
Optimized candidate selection by preserving match scores across hierarchical levels, preventing unnecessary tree expansion.
Extracted and chunked legal Section and Chapter notes to feed strict context to LLM reasoning.

title: Real-Time Multi-Stream Crowd Analytics & People Counter
subtitle: Distributed Computer Vision System with YOLOv8, CSRNet & HLS Streaming
description: High-throughput real-time video analytics platform detecting, counting, and analyzing crowd density across multiple simultaneous RTSP camera streams using CUDA-accelerated deep learning models.
architecture: RTSP IP Cameras -> OpenCV Video Capture -> YOLOv8 Detection & CSRNet Density Estimation (NVIDIA CUDA) -> FastAPI Stream Engine -> PostgreSQL Time-Series -> HLS Low-Latency Stream to Web Browser
highlights: Engineered deep learning crowd density estimation pipeline using CSRNet and YOLOv8 object tracking.
Integrated FastAPI backend with HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) for sub-second browser-based surveillance monitoring.
Deployed containerized pipelines onto Azure GPU Virtual Machines with NVIDIA CUDA acceleration.

title: ResiChain – Resilient Supply Chain & Logistics Platform
subtitle: Containerized Full-Stack Operations Engine with Automated Ingestion & Tracking
description: Enterprise logistics web platform managing shipment tracking, port logistics, and arrival ETAs. Automates heterogeneous Excel data ingestion, cleanses operational telemetry, and serves real-time performance analytics.
architecture: Angular Client -> FastAPI REST API -> SQLAlchemy Engine -> PostgreSQL Database -> Automated Excel Ingestion Cron -> AWS EC2 + S3 Storage
highlights: Developed full-stack application using Angular, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL.
Containerized application components via Docker and automated SSL certificate deployment on AWS EC2.
Implemented automated ingestion and validation of messy client-provided Excel manifests with alerting workflows.

title: Solana Web3 Token Hub & Analytics
subtitle: Decentralized Blockchain Explorer and Token Utility DApp
description: High-performance decentralized Web3 dashboard interacting directly with Solana RPC nodes using Next.js and Solana Web3.js to enable instantaneous token swaps, mint monitoring, and on-chain analytics.
architecture: Next.js 14 -> Solana Web3.js SDK -> Public Solana RPC Mainnet Cluster -> Client-side Wallet Adapters (Phantom/Solflare)
highlights: Built client-driven dApp using Next.js and TypeScript communicating directly with Solana blockchain clusters.
Engineered SPL token account balance parsing, transfer instructions, and real-time transaction signatures.
Designed responsive glassmorphism dark UI with live crypto transaction feeds.

title: AI Voice-Assisted IRCTC Booking Agent
subtitle: Award-Winning Multilingual Voice Chatbot (3rd Place Smart India Hackathon)
description: Multilingual voice-driven conversational agent allowing travelers to check train schedules, seat availability, and navigate rail booking operations using natural speech commands.
architecture: Microphone Audio -> Speech-to-Text STT -> Intent & Entity Parser (NLP) -> IRCTC API Connector -> Text-to-Speech TTS Audio Synthesis
highlights: Awarded 3rd place among 25 university teams in the Smart India Hackathon internal finals.
Implemented speech recognition and voice intent parsing for non-technical users accessing railway portals.
Engineered conversational error-recovery when station names were phonetically ambiguous.
